g.text: Singkatan: SA = Super Admin, AG = Admin Gudang, AT = Admin Toko, PO = Purchase Order, SR = Store Replenishment, TRX = nomor transaksi. Kode notifikasi (po_created, sr_shipped, …) = tipe notifikasi di server.
